RefreshTime:
Delayed uploading and unloading
Dongchen Bai.

The main function is to decide whether the packs appear immediately or when the next pack is refreshed after the conditions are met.

Fill in 0 or don't fill in --- Immediately up/down shelf
  The product will be uploaded or downloaded immediately after the condition of gift pack upload/download is met.

Fill in 1 --- upload/download in the next cycle.
  After the gift pack upload/download is satisfied, the product will not be uploaded or downloaded immediately, but at the next refresh (day or week).

   Example: The cycle refresh type of gift pack A and B is weekly refresh gift pack, the qualifying conditions on the equipment gift pack A pass 5-30 will appear, the equipment gift pack B pass 5-30 will disappear; the current level 4-20; assuming that the player passes the 5-30 now.
   Fill in 0 or do not fill in the conditions (pass 5-30) after the fulfillment of the conditions, A gift pack directly appear, B gift pack directly disappeared;
   Fill in 1 then A gift pack will appear in the next week, B gift pack will not disappear directly, but in the next week when the weekly refresh disappear.

Note: For event packs and newbie packs that do not have a refresh cycle, this field can only be left blank or filled with 0
